Allowed subject to all just exceptions.
The application stands disposed of.
This is a petition seeking quashing of the FIR No. 1128/2022 dated 18.12.2022 registered at PS Subhash Place under Section 498A/406/34 IPC.
The parties have arrived at a settlement dated 06.02.2023, wherein a total sum of Rs. 48 lakhs was to be paid to the respondent No.2 by the petitioner.
A sum of Rs. 40 lakhs has already been paid and the balance sum of Rs. 8 lakhs is being paid today vide DD No. 001184 dated 11.04.2023 drawn on HDFC Bank.
The petitioner is present in Court and has been identified by Mr. Rohit Verma, learned counsel.

The respondent No.2 is also present in Court and has been identified by Ms. Upasana Pahuja,
learned counsel and SI Sumit Kumar, PS Subhash Place.
The parties state that they have arrived at the settlement out of their own free will and without any threat, pressure, coercion or undue influence.
The respondent No. 2 states that she has no objection if the FIR is quashed.
There is no child born out of the wedlock.
For the reasons stated above, the FIR No. 1128/2022 Saurabh Sharma And Others vs The State And Anr on 20 April, 2023
